title: State ordinary refund paid-input cutoff beside the cap
detail: The ordinary exemption-with-credit row/base states a paid-input balance but does not state the HG93 point35¹(2) cutoff: paid when the audit starts. The investment row has this condition, while the ordinary route does not. This changes which input credits can be refunded. Add that condition to the ordinary row or its immediately connected calculation method.

title: State e-Factura scheme registration condition locally
detail: Code101⁶(1) limits this route to registered VAT taxpayers. The route row and the scheme-specific base paragraph list documented transactions/date/cap but omit that taxpayer condition; the Guide also covers a nonregistered vehicle route. Add registered VAT taxpayer next to the e-Factura eligibility rule.
